baseline.definition: Incumbent recipe refit per fold: unweighted closed-form ridge alpha=100 on standardized 14-d structural features, direct target scores[:,1]-scores[:,0]. Identical to challenger-heads-v1 baseline.
baseline.name: incumbent-refit

candidates.block: ast (16 dims, log1p counts; parsed on fenced code content when present else the full text; parse failure yields all-zero block with ast_parse_ok=0)
candidates.name: signals-ast

candidates.block: numeric (6 dims from the full text)
candidates.name: signals-numeric

candidates.block: choice (4 dims from the full text)
candidates.name: signals-choice

combined.definition: All three blocks appended at once (40-d total).
combined.name: signals-all

context_frozen.allocator: Identical to challenger-heads-v1: guarded costs frozen, select_fast_balanced with bundled caps/runaway/max_upgrade_fraction; premium untouched and cancels in paired deltas.
context_frozen.extractor_contract: Every extractor is pure stdlib (re + ast) so a passing candidate can be exported to src/ossp_router without new dependencies. Extractors are computed once per episode and cached.

decision_reasons.fail: No new signal block cleared the pre-registered gates on fresh seeds. The 14-d structural feature family stays champion and issue #21 guidance is updated accordingly.
decision_reasons.pass: A signal block beat the incumbent through the actual serving path on fresh seeds. This opens a promotion window only; stdlib runtime export requires a separate sealed integration protocol with feature-parity tests.

metric.delta_definition: Paired official weighted score difference (arm minus baseline): 0.4*deltaQ_fast + 0.3*deltaQ_balanced pooled per seed; premium cancels.

motivation.gap: Issue #21 guidance (objective change) is exhausted by E1-E1F; challenger-heads showed external model classes lose with existing features. The one untested direction is genuinely new signal sources as additional extractor blocks, not new estimators.
motivation.precedent: E1 ran four objective variants in one sealed protocol; this runs four feature-block variants under the same discipline.

multi_arm_rule: If several arms clear every gate, the window opens for the arm with the highest mean delta; ties resolve toward the smaller block (ast < numeric < choice < all).

seed_derivation.algorithm: digest_i = SHA256(UTF8(PREFIX) + NUL + bytes.fromhex(CORE) + i.to_bytes(4,'big')); seed_i = int.from_bytes(digest_i[:4],'big') & 0x7fffffff; collision fails closed.
